mapper.sql: r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.all_permissions_yn, r.used_yn, r.built_in_yn, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_role r WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM app_role r WHERE r.code = #{code}
SELECT FROM app_role r ORDER BY r.code ASC
SELECT FROM app_role r WHERE r.id IN #{id} ORDER BY r.code ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM app_user u JOIN app_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN app_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.all_permissions_yn = 'Y' AND r.used_yn = 'Y' AND u.enabled = 'Y' AND u.id <> #{excludedUserId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_role (code, name, description, all_permissions_yn, used_yn, built_in_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{superAdmin}, #{used}, #{builtIn}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
